hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook for ETH/phiEth pools that performs 1:1 swaps by intercepting beforeSwap, converting tokens via phiEth.deposit()/withdraw(), settling output to PoolManager, and returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity AMM math. Direct liquidity addition to the pool is blocked via beforeAddLiquidity revert.
